title: Apple Health
description: CloudLab Apple Health export and workout history.

panels.title: 每日同步步数
panels.description: 按北京时间分日汇总已同步的步数。

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Shanghai")

from(bucket: "apple-health")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "step_count_count" and r._field == "qty")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: 心率
panels.description: 按面板时间分辨率显示已同步心率的平均值。

targets.query:
from(bucket: "apple-health")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heart_rate_data_bpm" and r._field == "qty")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: 每日步行和跑步距离
panels.description: 按北京时间分日汇总已同步的步行和跑步距离。

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Shanghai")

from(bucket: "apple-health")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "walking_running_distance_km" and r._field == "qty")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: 训练次数
panels.description: 所选时段内带有训练时长的已同步活动。

targets.query:
from(bucket: "apple-health")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "workout" and r._field == "duration_min")
  |> group()
  |> count(column: "_value")

panels.title: 训练总时长
panels.description: 所选时段内已同步活动的训练时长合计。

targets.query:
from(bucket: "apple-health")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "workout" and r._field == "duration_min")
  |> group()
  |> sum(column: "_value")

panels.title: 训练记录
panels.description: 按开始时间展示已同步训练的时长、距离和心率。

targets.query:
from(bucket: "apple-health")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "workout")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["duration_min", "distance_km", "avgHeartRate_bpm", "maxHeartRate_bpm"]))
  |> toFloat()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> rename(fn: (column) =>
    if column == "_time" then "训练开始时间"
    else if column == "duration_min" then "时长 (min)"
    else if column == "distance_km" then "距离 (km)"
    else if column == "avgHeartRate_bpm" then "平均心率 (bpm)"
    else if column == "maxHeartRate_bpm" then "最高心率 (bpm)"
    else column)
  |> sort(columns: ["训练开始时间"], desc: true)
